description: Folder-path -> Entra group IDs. Paths are the src_key (object path relative to the S3 bucket root) and are mode-independent (same keys for source_mode=s3_shortcut or s3_direct). A file inherits the ACL of the nearest ancestor folder present here; a subfolder entry OVERRIDES its parent (e.g. hr/onboarding below adds a second group on top of hr). Groups are Entra group object IDs (GUIDs). See PRODUCT_SPEC.md section 10.
